summary.text: Johnny Mautz is a Republican Maryland state senator from District 37 on the Eastern Shore who has held the seat since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney by training, he previously served in the House of Delegates from 2015 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Johnny Mautz was born in Fort Devens, Massachusetts, on September 19, 1970, and attended Brewster Academy in Wolfeboro, New Hampshire.
He earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Dayton in 1994 and a J.D. from the Pettit College of Law at Ohio Northern University in 1997.

Mautz served as counsel to the U.S. House Judiciary Committee from 1997 to 2002, as a special assistant in the office of Gov. Robert Ehrlich from 2002 to 2005, and as legislative director to U.S. Rep. Howard Coble from 2009 to 2014.
He has also managed the Carpenter Street Saloon in St. Michaels.
Mautz represented District 37B in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2015 to 2023.
He assumed office in the state Senate on January 11, 2023, succeeding Adelaide Eckardt.
According to the General Assembly website, he serves on the Finance Committee.
